about: Figure data checked by code-figures' schemas (M6.4 spec, M6FG.2). Python (tests/figures/test_cases.py) and the web (apps/web/src/figures/cases.test.ts) both run every case: `codes` are the distinct codes the schema alone finds, in order of first appearance; a component's own checks are not run here.
